definitions.v: RNA ring centroid minus protein ring centroid, in the protein ring frame (z is the protein normal)
definitions.phi: arccos(|v_z|/d), the angle from the protein normal; stage 3's slip angle is the same phi
definitions.theta: arccos(min(1, |R33|)), the angle between the two ring normals
definitions.normals: Kabsch fit of each ring onto the reference rings (G->A, U->C, TYR->PHE)

grid.layout: canonical: rows/translations with >=1 accepted pair; int32 sizes/concat

notes.decisions: accept = score >= cutoff and the applied mask and the name's prefilters
notes.boundary_points: phi/theta boundary goldens (phi 45, 44.99999; theta 30, 29.99999) sit at the conditional mean of the other two descriptors given the fixed one, so the score is far above the cutoff and only the prefilter decides
notes.lattice_decisions: mask_accept covers the applied mask and the name's prefilters only; no score
